title: 两个篮子和一张清单  (Two Baskets and a List)

segments.t: 菩提树庭院客栈的保险丝烧断二十分钟后，厨房恢复了供电，格雷厄姆正在庭院里测量铜线。汉娜和泰莎臂弯里挎着两个编织篮，走进周六清晨清新的空气中。请先听一遍完整的场景。
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.
现在我们来一步步回顾这个场景。
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
‘烤箱又热起来了！格雷厄姆，你救了我的周六面包。’要感谢别人及时救下了这炉面包，只需使用直接的过去式
You saved
后面接上 Saturday bread，这里星期几直接放在名词前面作定语修饰它。
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
‘只要让亚瑟的手指在晚上之前离每个墙壁开关远一点就行。’要表示保持安全距离，可以把 keep 与
away from
搭配使用，而 wall switch 则指装在墙上的开关。
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
‘你给九号房间重接电线的时候，我和泰莎步行去周六集市。’前缀 re- 表示重复或彻底翻新整套线路，体现在
rewire
这个词里，这里用于指九号房间的旧电线。
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
‘你们带了手写清单吗，还是打算买下半个广场？’write 的不规则过去分词在名词前作形容词，构成
written list,
而 half the square 则幽默地夸张形容想把一切都买下来的冲动。
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
‘就在这纸上呢，格雷厄姆：十二只白杯子、新鲜柠檬和本地蜂蜜。’要亮出白纸黑字写下的东西，说成
Right here on paper,
显得非常生动，注意 on 和 paper 之间不加冠词。
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
‘外加四罐甜果酱，还有种在庭院花盆里的绿香草！’在口头报清单追加物品时，
Plus four jars
能够利落地衔接上补充的内容。
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
‘好。顺便在五金摊买一卷黑胶带回来。’当顺路经过商店买东西或取东西时，可以用上
Pick up
而 hardware stall 指的是五金工具摊位。
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
‘一卷黑色电工胶带，用铅笔写下来了！’在 write 后面加上 down 强调把东西记在纸上的动作：
written down in pencil!
并用介词 in 引出书写工具。
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
‘现在你总算学聪明了，汉娜。把桌上的零钱袋拿上。’两个简短的名词组成了
cash pouch
其中 pouch 指带封口的小袋子或小包。
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
‘快走吧，汉娜，趁最好的黄柠檬还没被抢光！’想要亲切地催促对方，
Come on,
能鼓励人立刻动身出发。
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
‘格雷厄姆，我们在集市上需要额外的椅子吗？’在复数名词前面，
extra chairs
中的 extra 保持词形不变，永远不加 -s。
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.
‘亚瑟说他要打电话订六把折叠椅。祝我们好运吧。’可以折叠收纳的椅子叫做
folding chairs
而 Wish us luck 则带着调侃的意味收尾，暗示让亚瑟自己打电话订货有多让人不放心。让我们再连贯地听一遍完整对话。
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.
臂弯里挎着篮子，清单上用铅笔记下了电工胶带，汉娜和泰莎动身前往周六集市，而亚瑟则在无人看管的情况下独自打电话下订单。我们很快在摊位间再见。
See you soon!
